title: Astronauts Come Home After 237 Days in Space
summary:
Four astronauts are back on Earth after more than seven months on the International Space Station. Their SpaceX capsule splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean near Los Angeles on Thursday.

The Crew-12 team was NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, European astronaut Sophie Adenot and Russian cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev. They spent 237 days in space. They circled Earth more than 3,792 times and traveled over 100 million miles!

Rescue teams on ships quickly reached the capsule. After health checks, the crew was heading to NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston.

In space, the crew did many science experiments. One tested ways to make stem cells, which might help treat sick people someday. Another tested a machine that makes IV fluids, the liquids doctors give patients. Other studies looked at food and blood flow in space.

NASA says this research will help astronauts stay healthy on future trips to the Moon and Mars. Jessica Meir also did four spacewalks on this mission.
why_it_matters: The experiments could help future astronauts explore the Moon and Mars and may even help doctors treat sick people on Earth.
